notes.title: Solitaire of Stygian Shadows is released!
notes.content:
[p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3666180/Solitaire_of_Stygian_Shadows/"][/dynamiclink]Solitaire of Stygian Shadows, a solitaire game with randomly generated card layouts is released on Steam!
You can join the Discord to discuss the game or report errors here: [url="https://discord.gg/StwnxP6"]https://discord.gg/StwnxP6[/url][/p]
